column1: # ESP32 Football Tracker — partition table
# Deliberately identical in layout to the stock Arduino "default with OTA"
# table that shipped on the board (verified by reading flash at 0x8000)
# there are no surprises and the factory geometry is preserved.
# Both OTA slots are kept: on a sealed device with no debug header
# to roll back a bad firmware is worth more than the ~1.28 MB that reclaiming
# app1 would add to the filesystem. 1472 KB is already ample for our cache.
# The data partition keeps the "spiffs" name because Arduino's LittleFS driver
# looks for that label by default — the name is historical
# LittleFS.
# A 64 KB coredump partition is included for the same reason we keep both OTA
# slots: this device has no debug header
